MINI MINUTES: This Cause came as assigned from the Presiding Judge Master Calendar for Court Trial.
Commissioner Sue M. Kaplan, Clerk: S. Ravinantapricha, CSR: Leticia Perez.
Plaintiff: Henry Chan present with counsel, Charles Bronitsky.
Defendant: Danee Asemgar present with counsel, George Rush.
11:20 am. - Parties and counsels present in court with JPT: Seymour Seidscher.
Parties met JPT and reached a settlement by stipulation, terms read into the record as follows:
Plaintiff will return to Defendant, one of the three checks in possesion representing the rent from Dec. 2003.
Defendant will remain in possession of the property located at 814 California St., #16, San Francisco, until May 31, 2004. The security deposit in the amount of $1,430.00 plus any interest will be refunded, Plaintiff will provides the Defendant with a letter of references, and terms of the settlement to be kept confidential.
All parties agreed to the settlement in open court.
The Court deemed the matter settled and trial date is vacated.
